Question 4
?

The curve C is the intersection of a surface S, defined by z=f(x,y), with the plane x=2. Given that the point P(2,π4,0) lies on C, and that fy=4sin⁡(xy), find the equations of the tangent line to C at P.

a
{x=2z=2y+π
b
{x=2z=2y−π2
c
{x=2z=4y−π2
d
{x=2z=4y−π
e
{x=2z=4y
